eligible_conditions: Depression screening for Medicare beneficiaries in primary care settings with staff-assisted depression care supports
exclusions: Diseases, complications, or chronic conditions resulting from depression
Therapeutic interventions such as pharmacotherapy, combination therapy (counseling and medications), or other interventions for depression
citations: NCD 210.9 - Screening for Depression in Adults
U.S. Preventive Services Task Force (USPSTF) Grade B recommendation
